notes.title: Collection Quest Free-to-play + Supporter Pack DLC NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Collection Quest is Officially Free-to-Play and 
the "Collection Quest - Digital Goodies Supporter Pack" is now Live!

As a token of appreciation, 
anyone who purchased the game has received the DLC for free.

A Giant Thank You to Everyone!

Seeing the threads and discussions gives me life,
here's to the years to come!

notes.title: To celebrate 3 years, Collection Quest is going Free-to-Play on June 13th!
notes.notes:
Collection Quest was my first attempt at releasing a game on steam.

Taking that plunge has lead to the release of Bullet Quest, starting a YouTube channel
and my current work on a third unannounced game.
These titles have help me hone my craft.

Collection Quest holds a very special place in my heart and 
I wanted to do something special to celebrate it.

So to celebrate CQ and the past 3 years, on June 13th Collection Quest will be going Free-to-Play!
If you want to support Collection Quest a post-commentary DLC will be launching as well. 

As a way to say Thank You, anyone who already owns the game will receive the post-commentary DLC for free.

Cheers!
